semiconductor_relevance: High — Annealsys specializes in advanced thermal processing and deposition equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Annealsys provides innovative Rapid Thermal Processing (RTP) and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) systems designed for both research and production applications. Their equipment supports a wide range of materials and processes, making them a key player in the semiconductor fabrication landscape.
capabilities: Rapid Thermal Processing (RTP) systems for silicon carbide implant annealing
Direct Liquid Injection CVD systems for a variety of materials including metals and 2D materials
High temperature RTP furnaces capable of reaching up to 2000°C
Multi-process capabilities including CVD, ALD, and MOCVD in a single chamber
